component.name: SettingsView

Label.text: OK: edit setting Back: return to menu

component.script:
sub init() m.serverList = m.top.findNode("serverList") m.serverList.observeField("itemSelected", "onServerSelected") m.top.observeField("focusRequested", "onFocusRequested") m.top.observeField("serverUrl", "onServerUrlChanged") m.editingIndex = -1 buildSettingsContent() end sub
sub buildSettingsContent() serverContent = createObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") serverItem = serverContent.createChild("ContentNode") serverItem.title = "Server URL" serverItem.description = m.top.serverUrl m.serverList.content = serverContent end sub
sub onServerUrlChanged() buildSettingsContent() end sub
sub onFocusRequested() m.serverList.setFocus(true) end sub
sub onServerSelected() m.editingIndex = 0 showKeyboard("Server URL", m.top.serverUrl) end sub
sub showKeyboard(title as string, currentValue as string) dialog = createObject("roSGNode", "KeyboardDialog") dialog.title = "Edit " + title dialog.buttons = ["OK", "Cancel"] dialog.text = currentValue dialog.observeField("buttonSelected", "onKeyboardButton") dialog.observeField("wasClosed", "onKeyboardClosed") m.keyboardDialog = dialog m.top.getScene().dialog = dialog end sub
sub onKeyboardButton(event as object) buttonIndex = event.getData() if buttonIndex = 0 newValue = m.keyboardDialog.text if m.editingIndex = 0 saveSetting("server_url", newValue) m.top.serverUrl = newValue m.top.settingChanged = { key: "server_url", value: newValue } end if end if m.keyboardDialog.close = true end sub
sub onKeyboardClosed() m.keyboardDialog = invalid m.editingIndex = -1 m.serverList.setFocus(true) end sub
sub saveSetting(key as string, value as string) section = createObject("roRegistrySection", "AppSettings") section.write(key, value) section.flush() end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if not press then return false if key = "back" or key="left" m.top.closeRequested = true return true end if return false end function
